notes.title: 🤖 Break-a-bot final update!
notes.content:
🆕 What’s New:
👊 Zippy’s Got Arms! – Zippy now starts with his own fists, punch your way to your first upgrade, or try finishing the game with just those for a Steam achievement
🏆 Steam Achievements – how many can you get?
💥 Improved VFX – Punchier, clearer, and more satisfying visuals
⚔️ Combat Tweaks & Balancing – Tighter, smoother fights all around
🛠️ Bug Fixes – Tons of them, thanks to your reports

While this is our final content update, we’ll still be around in Discord if you need help or want to share feedback.

Break-a-bot was created as a student project, and since we’ve wrapped up our studies, we won’t be continuing regular development.

Thanks again for playing, supporting us, and being part of the Break-a-bot journey ❤️

notes.title: 💥 Break-a-bot – New Update Available! 🤖
notes.content:
🆕 What’s New:
💥 Destructible Objects – Tear through the environment and watch the world react
👹 New Boss Fight – A brutal new enemy stands in your way
⚠️ Environmental Hazards – Traps, dangers, and surprises around every corner
🎥 Updated Camera System – Smoother tracking and improved gameplay feel

As always, your feedback keeps the gears turning — let us know what you think, and stay tuned for more updates soon!
